title: Natural Language Processing
description: Embeddings, RNN/LSTM/GRU, attention mechanisms, Transformer architecture, and BERT/GPT concepts with TensorFlow.
objectives: Implement RNN, LSTM, and GRU networks
Use pretrained embeddings for NLP tasks
keyTakeaways: Word embeddings encode semantic similarity geometrically — king - man + woman ≈ queen is a real example
LSTM gates (input, forget, output) selectively update the cell state, allowing the network to remember long-range dependencies
Attention = learned weighted sum over all encoder states; gives the decoder access to any input position, not just the last hidden state
Transformer: self-attention + position-wise FFN + positional encoding — no recurrence, fully parallelizable during training
BERT (encoder) is pretrained with masked LM + NSP; fine-tune on downstream tasks by adding a task-specific head
